feedback: No news access made it impossible to tell whether the big pre-market gaps (KYMR +30% at a round 150.00, ZS +20%, CRWD -7% against the market, UNH -6%) were data, earnings or a buyout. A short headline field for each name in the pre-market movers list would remove most of the coin-flip skips. Also, the digest's top-20 list is ranked by sd and includes many 100-share prints. A minimum-volume filter on that list would show more tradeable names.
